sessions.phase_label: Android modernization, localization, visual cleanup, and tutorial redesign
Android completion review and demo preparation

requirements.title: Source-Code Assessment
requirements.definition: Review the supplied Android and iOS source code and report concrete modernization and improvement needs.
requirements.boundary_note: This is retained as an independently requested assessment deliverable; implementing the resulting recommendations belongs to separate product Requirements.

requirements.title: Android Platform Compatibility
requirements.definition: Modernize the Android application to use supported APIs and dependencies and remain compatible with current Android platform requirements.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Android OS targeting, deprecated API replacement, and dependency modernization as one compatibility mechanism; permissions, bundle packaging, and package size have independent acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: iOS Platform Compatibility
requirements.definition: Modernize the iOS application to use supported APIs, including replacing UIWebView, and support current iOS platform requirements.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers iOS runtime and API compatibility; the privacy manifest and signing configuration are separate store-readiness obligations.

requirements.title: iOS Privacy Manifest
requirements.definition: Include the privacy manifest required for contemporary Apple App Store submission.
requirements.boundary_note: The privacy manifest is independently verifiable and can be completed without changing general iOS API compatibility or signing.

requirements.title: iOS Signing Configuration
requirements.definition: Restore valid iOS signing configuration so current builds can be produced and distributed.
requirements.boundary_note: Signing and certificate renewal are operationally independent from source modernization and the privacy manifest.

requirements.title: Android Permission Compliance
requirements.definition: Remove unused sensitive Android permissions so the application requests only permissions required by its behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Permission minimization has its own store-review and security acceptance criterion and is not merely an attribute of Android API modernization.

requirements.title: Android Download Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Reduce the Android application's user download size substantially while retaining required functionality and localization.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the Android size outcome and related optimization strategy; App Bundle delivery is a separately verifiable packaging behavior.

requirements.title: iOS Download Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Reduce the iOS application's user download size substantially while retaining required functionality and localization.
requirements.boundary_note: The iOS size outcome can differ from Android and has its own platform-specific trajectory; iOS thinning is separately testable packaging behavior.

requirements.title: Android App Bundle Packaging
requirements.definition: Produce the Android application using Android App Bundle packaging for Google Play distribution.
requirements.boundary_note: Bundle format can be implemented and accepted independently from whether the resulting download reaches the desired size.

requirements.title: iOS App Thinning
requirements.definition: Use iOS thinning or slicing so users receive only the application resources appropriate to their devices.
requirements.boundary_note: Thinning is an independently configurable delivery mechanism rather than merely a numeric app-size attribute.

requirements.title: Full Application Localization
requirements.definition: Localize the complete Android and iOS application interface across the client-selected Google Play and App Store language sets.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns general application strings and selected language coverage; RTL layout, localized social links, FAQ content, and tutorial delivery can change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Right-to-Left Layout Support
requirements.definition: Render the application correctly for right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian.
requirements.boundary_note: RTL layout behavior can fail even when strings are translated correctly, so it remains separate from general localization.

requirements.title: Localized Social Media Links
requirements.definition: Provide localized social-media link behavior for the application's supported language contexts.
requirements.boundary_note: Social-link destinations and routing are independently testable and should not be hidden as a generic application-string attribute.

requirements.title: Ruler Magnifier Tracking
requirements.definition: Position the magnifier over the measurement ruler and have it follow the ruler's path correctly.
requirements.boundary_note: Magnifier position and motion form one interaction behavior; number alignment and title clipping can fail independently.

requirements.title: Ruler Number Alignment
requirements.definition: Display the ruler's numeric labels in their correct aligned positions.
requirements.boundary_note: Numeric-label alignment has a separate visual acceptance criterion from magnifier tracking and title visibility.

requirements.title: Scoliometer Title Visibility
requirements.definition: Display the Scoliometer title without clipping or truncation.
requirements.boundary_note: Text clipping is independently observable and fixable and should not be merged into unrelated ruler interaction behavior.

requirements.title: App Skin Graphics Cleanup
requirements.definition: Clean up the application's skin graphics so the available visual themes are consistently presented.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns cleanup across the visual skins; measurement-control defects and iPad-specific layout behavior remain separate.

requirements.title: iPad Layout Cleanup
requirements.definition: Correct the application's iPad-specific layout and presentation problems.
requirements.boundary_note: The iPad layout can require a distinct responsive-layout fix even when phone skins look correct; client acceptance of its exact extent is indirect.

requirements.title: How-To-Use Content Delivery
requirements.definition: Provide functional How-To-Use guidance through the client-selected content and delivery mechanism on both mobile platforms.
requirements.boundary_note: Tutorial images, translated overlays, and streamed video are successive delivery values of one help mechanism; app-size outcomes remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Chinese Youku Video Removal
requirements.definition: Remove the obsolete Chinese Youku video integration from the application.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an explicit removal decision for a legacy regional integration, not a modification of the replacement universal How-To video.

requirements.title: Localized In-App FAQ
requirements.definition: Provide FAQ content in both Android and iOS and implement it as localizable application strings.
requirements.boundary_note: The FAQ is independently requested help content that can be added or changed without modifying the rest of the application's translated strings.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer repeatedly asks whether users need an in-app language selector, but no client decision establishes this as a Requirement.
The client requires localized social-media links, but the evidence does not clarify whether this means translated labels, language-specific destinations, or region-specific accounts.
iPad-specific layout cleanup appears independently meaningful, but the client only indirectly accepts its scope through broader graphics-cleanup discussion.
